svg.font-family: Inter, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
svg.title: Branch-wise molecular evolution (synthetic)
svg.desc: A karyon sheet of 4 panels in 2 columns: panel A, A cool-to-warm logarithmic scale centres the branch model on ω = 1; thick branches pass q ≤ 0.05.; panel B, Host, resistance and protein identity remain separate terminal datasets around the selection tree.; panel C, Direct branch estimates survive the unrooted projection; dotted edges make missing fits visible.; panel D, A cladogram removes branch-length magnitude without changing the ω estimate owned by each edge..

g.title: panel A, A cool-to-warm logarithmic scale centres the branch model on ω = 1; thick branches pass q ≤ 0.05.

svg.font-family: Inter, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
svg.text: Where selection changes along the tree

g.title: dN/dS ω 1.02 (approximately neutral); q 0.77 (> 0.05); event A150V
Branch dN/dS (ω); cool branches ω < 0.9; neutral 0.9–1.1; warm branches ω > 1.1
panel B, Host, resistance and protein identity remain separate terminal datasets around the selection tree.

svg.font-family: Inter, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
svg.text: Selection with a genomic metadata halo

g.title: Branch dN/dS (ω); cool branches ω < 0.9; neutral 0.9–1.1; warm branches ω > 1.1
panel C, Direct branch estimates survive the unrooted projection; dotted edges make missing fits visible.

svg.font-family: Inter, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
svg.text: The same branch estimates without a privileged root

g.title: Branch dN/dS (ω); cool branches ω < 0.9; neutral 0.9–1.1; warm branches ω > 1.1

Host, resistance and protein identity remain separate terminal datasets around the selection tree.
